about.title: Moving Cairo, one smarter trip at a time
about.subtitle: Mwasalaty brings Greater Cairo's buses and metro into a single app — plan a route, pay, and ride with a digital QR ticket, online or off.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.problem: Getting around Greater Cairo means juggling buses, the metro, and guesswork. Schedules, fares, and connections are scattered, and there's no simple way to plan a full door-to-door trip or pay for it in one place.
mission.statement: We unify Cairo's public transport into one clear journey — combining bus and metro into door-to-door routes you can compare, pay for, and carry as a digital ticket. Our goal is to make public transport the easy, obvious choice for everyone in the city.

route.title: Multi-modal route planning
route.desc: Door-to-door journeys that combine bus and metro across Greater Cairo, built on real OpenStreetMap and GTFS transit data.

filters.title: Routes that fit you
filters.desc: Compare every trip by fastest, cheapest, or most comfortable, and pick the option that matches how you want to travel.

ai.title: Ask in your own words
ai.desc: Tell our AI assistant where you're going in plain Arabic or English, and it finds the route — no forms, just a sentence.

ticket.title: Digital QR ticketing
ticket.desc: Buy once and get a QR ticket valid for 24 hours, with per-leg scanning and refunds for journeys you don't take.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: An installable PWA that caches your routes and tickets, so your trip keeps working even when the signal drops.

operator.title: Built for operators too
operator.desc: A dedicated scanner app lets bus and metro operators validate tickets in real time — fully bilingual in Arabic and English.

plan.title: Plan
plan.desc: Search your start and destination, or just ask the AI, and compare bus and metro routes side by side.

pay.title: Pay
pay.desc: Check out securely and get a digital QR ticket valid for 24 hours from your trip.

ride.title: Ride & scan
ride.desc: Follow live step-by-step navigation and show your QR to the operator's scanner on each leg.

team.title: The team
team.subtitle: Mwasalaty was built as a graduation project at ITI (Information Technology Institute) by a team passionate about transport and technology.

cta.title: Ready to move smarter?
cta.subtitle: Plan your next trip across Cairo, or reach out if you have a question.
